name: loyal-spark
description: Onchain loyalty on Base for merchants and AI agents. Wires Gemini CLI to Loyal Spark merchant (lsk_) and holder (rwk_) Streamable HTTP MCP servers.
author: Yuri Gerasimov <admin@loyalspark.online>

settings.name: Merchant API key
settings.description: Optional Loyal Spark merchant key (lsk_...). Leave blank for keyless initialize/tools/list and get_platform_info.

settings.name: Holder API key
settings.description: Optional Loyal Spark holder key (rwk_...). Free via SIWE. Leave blank if you only use the merchant server.
